title: Native bootstrap public-original exchange request v1
description: Exactly one canonical sorted ASCII JSON object plus LF, at most 192 KiB including LF. Decoding grants no authority; the native receiver independently authenticates each original and the actual caller. JSON Schema does not establish canonical wire spelling, aggregate length or cryptographic validity.
